crossRefs.note: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple…
I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,
which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.
Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he…
Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
Exalt Yahweh our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!
Exalt Yahweh, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for Yahweh, our God, is holy!
How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast the beauty of Israel down from…

translations.web: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.
translations.bsb: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
translations.kjv: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
translations.asv: We will go into his tabernacles; We will worship at his footstool.
